subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures suppress warnings whenever `includeDetails` is true, including mutating, heartbeat, cron, and full-verbose paths, or should those detail paths remain visible?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally preserve some detailed exec warnings, while the linked issue asks for unconditional suppression; automation should not choose that product policy silently.

options.title: Split Ordinary Chat From Detail Modes
options.body: Suppress ordinary handled exec-like chat noise, but preserve explicit cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail paths unless a maintainer chooses to retire them.

options.title: Suppress Exec-Like Warnings Everywhere
options.body: Move exec-like suppression before mutating handling and update the existing detail-mode tests to make the no-warning contract explicit.

options.title: Keep Current Detail Behavior
options.body: Do not merge this PR as a fix; narrow or close the linked issue around the existing verbose, cron, and heartbeat detail contract.

recommendation.title: Split Ordinary Chat From Detail Modes
recommendation.body: Suppress ordinary handled exec-like chat noise, but preserve explicit cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail paths unless a maintainer chooses to retire them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this handle to the mutation helper and warning-policy surfaces that control the disputed behavior.
